manifest.name: dsh-plugin-openai-api
manifest.description: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions (streaming and non-streaming) and /v1/models endpoint on the DSH web server: one DSH agent session per (API key, X-Agent-Preset) pair.

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-openai-api bundle patch: the profile layer that mounts this
# package. `dsh plugin add` joins it into `dsh.profile.bundles` (the CLI
# reconciles the layer list against installed state).
#
# The row ships DISABLED — the install is inert. Enable it in the user's
# profile patch layer (~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml):
#   - id: openai-api
#     disabled: false
# An id-targeted `config` in that layer replaces the row's config block
# whole (no deep merge).
#
# The plugin mounts GET /v1/models and POST /v1/chat/completions on the web
# server (same port as the GUI; base URL http://127.0.0.1:3080/v1). One DSH
# agent session backs one (API key, `X-Agent-Preset`) pair — each accepted
# key is a separate tenant, so different keys never share a session;
# requests without the header share one default-preset session per key.
- insert:
    - id: openai-api
      name: dsh-plugin-openai-api
      disabled: true
      config:
        # Model id advertised at /v1/models and used for sessions whose first
        # request does not name a model. Default: 'default' (the host default
        # model; the wire still says 'default').
        # model: my-model

        # Provider route for created sessions (the AgentOptions.provider
        # meaning — the host's provider routing). Default: host default.
        # provider: my-provider

        # Client keys: each key is a SEPARATE tenant — a session is one
        # (key, preset) pair, so different keys never share a session
        # even for the same preset, and a client reconnecting with its key
        # resumes its own session. A request must present exactly one of
        # them (Authorization: Bearer <key>); any other key is a 401.
        # When unset the endpoint is UNAUTHENTICATED — keep the web server
        # bound to loopback (the web plugin's host: 127.0.0.1 default).
        # (The old single `apiKey` key is gone: `apiKey: change-me` is now
        # an unknown-key load error.)
        # apiKeys:
        #   - change-me-key-a
        #   - change-me-key-b

        # Absolute working directory for created sessions. Default: the
        # dsh web process's own working directory (every session always
        # carries a cwd — the deployment persona renders it).
        # cwd: /home/noname/projects

readme.text: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a running `dsh web` server: ``` GET /v1/models POST /v1/chat/completions (non-streaming and SSE streaming) ```

Install the plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/openai-api
```

(From a DSH source checkout, the same command is `pnpm dsh plugin …`.
A plain path links the source, so edits are picked up on restart. Fresh
checkout of this repo: recreate `node_modules` first —
`ln -s /path/to/deepseek-harness/apps/cli/node_modules node_modules`.)

Uninstall the plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-openai-api
```

Restart `dsh web` after either.

Append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (the install ships
`disabled: true`):

```yaml
- id: openai-api
  disabled: false
  config:
    model: default

The `config` block replaces the plugin's defaults wholesale. Set
`disabled: true` to switch the endpoint off. Restart `dsh web` after
changes. All keys are optional:

| key | default | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `default` | The model id advertised at `/v1/models`. A request's `model` (absent, or this id) → the host's default model selection; any other id is passed through to the session. |
| `provider` | host default | The provider route created sessions use. |
| `apiKeys` | unset (no auth) | Non-empty array of client keys. When set, a request must present one of them (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`), else 401. A key identifies the caller; it does not select the preset. |
| `cwd` | the `dsh web` process's working directory | Working directory for created sessions. Must start with `/`. |

The contract is OpenAI's — it just works.

```js
import OpenAI from 'openai'

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v1',

The same, without an SDK (the `Bearer` header only when you set
`apiKeys`):

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer local-key' \
  -H 'X-Agent-Preset: custom-agent-preset' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

The agent preset id the session joins — any id in
`~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`, plus the shipped presets.

- Absent → the default preset (`standard`).
- Unknown id → 400 with the roster; repeated or comma-joined → 400.
- Resolved at session creation only: the same (key, preset) pair always
  resumes the same session; a different value is a different session.
